hook.text: Vampire bats share blood meals with unrelated roostmates who failed to feed that night.

buildup.text: They remember who shared and who didn't. Bats that refuse to share get refused next time.

discovery.text: This is reciprocal altruism: help now, get help later. It works when individuals interact repeatedly.

twist.text: Cheaters—bats that take but never give—get excluded. The system is self-policing through memory.

climax.text: Reciprocal altruism is the biological version of tit-for-tat: cooperate, track, and punish defectors.

punchline.text: In nature, favors come with a ledger.
